note: build-time evidence ledger. Citations are 'path:line[-line]' relative to the clone project root (the folder that contains design-repo/). extraction/verify_all.py re-reads them when that source tree is beside this folder and degrades to warnings when design-repo/ is used standalone.

sourceStack.value: React ^18.3.1 + Vite ^5.4.10 + Tailwind CSS ^3.4.14 (tailwind.config.cjs, CommonJS) + react-router-dom ^6.28.0 (package.json ranges); dev server port 5197

sectionHeights.method: headless Chromium 1440x900, reduced motion, full scroll to settle lazy images, then getBoundingClientRect of every direct child of <main> plus the announcement bar, nav and footer; each child mapped in order to the route's reference PageSpec node

responsiveHeights.note: representative route per implemented template at 1280/768/375 (same method)

renderedStyleSamples.note: computed styles sampled from the rendered clone (getComputedStyle) to confirm the token layer matches what actually renders

specParity.note: clone section heights vs the ORIGINAL site's heights recorded in the project's own specs (CLONE_SPEC.md page map, specs/T1-T4.md section tables). This is geometric parity per section, NOT a pixel comparison: no live-site capture was made in this build.

comparisons.specLabel: Feature panel 1: text left, GIF right (gradient-05)
Feature panel 2: GIF left, text right (gradient-02)
Feature panel 3: text left, GIF right (gradient-12)

cloneQuality.runnable: clean install = `npm ci` then `npm run dev` (port 5197) / `npm run build`; package-lock.json present. node_modules and dist are never shipped with the design-repo.
cloneQuality.pixelParity: NOT MEASURED in this build (no live-original capture; the build is scoped to the clone). Prior audits by other agents claim homepage within 1px and T1-T4 representatives within +/-2px at 1440 - recorded here as unverified-by-this-pass; the geometric specParity above is this pass's own measurement.

preExistingClaimChecks.claim: CLONE_SPEC.md section 3: reveal IntersectionObserver threshold 0.25 + rootMargin '0px 0px -40px 0px' (marked inferred)
preExistingClaimChecks.finding: the clone's code uses threshold 0.3 (>= 1023px) / 0.1 below, no rootMargin, observer delay 100ms on mobile, read from the original's code; the spec's inferred values were superseded. The design-repo records the code values.

preExistingClaimChecks.claim: specs/T1-T4.md T3: redshift (clone /data-platforms/northwind) section 2 is a statement 'without diagram (831)'
preExistingClaimChecks.finding: the clone renders a 16:9 video poster there (content comment: 'the original embeds a video player here'); measured 831.2px, matching the spec height. The spec wording omits the media block; contracts follow the code (content.statement#video).

preExistingClaimChecks.claim: PAGES.md T4 section 5 is a 'logo/tech grid'
preExistingClaimChecks.finding: already corrected in specs/T1-T4.md (it is the testimonial slider); the clone and this repo use social-proof.testimonial-slider#industry.
every T1 hero renders primary + secondary (variant requiredFields include secondary).

preExistingClaimChecks.claim: PAGES.md: N-feat variants A and B differ (bottom-frequency wash vs photo wash)
preExistingClaimChecks.finding: in the clone both render the same .bottom-frequency CSS wash (Feat.jsx `washed = wash ?? (variant === 'A' || variant === 'B')`; an explicit `wash: false` gives the plain-icon variant), so they are one variant (wash-icon) here.
announcement bar autoplays every 8000ms with a 500ms transition; all sliders use 400ms cubic-bezier(.25,1,.5,1) and never autoplay.

preExistingClaimChecks.claim: brief: homepage within 1px / T1-T4 within +/-2px at 1440 (prior audit)
preExistingClaimChecks.finding: geometric re-check against the specs' recorded original heights: at 1440 every section of the 5 representatives is within 23.6px; homepage document heights at 1440/1280/768/375 are within 1px. Below 1440 the T1-T4 representatives deviate up to 58.2px per section, so a +/-2px claim holds at 1440 only. Pixel parity was not re-measured.
reveal, marquee and brush strokes have prefers-reduced-motion rules; the announcement autoplay and sliders do not (recorded as a gap in motion-patterns.json, not enforced).

preExistingClaimChecks.claim: specs/T1-T4.md N-baton: the S6 stroke behind N-tabs-dark draws on when it enters the viewport
preExistingClaimChecks.finding: the current clone renders the tabs-dark stroke `idle` (no draw-on; fill hidden at >=768), per a later measurement of the original noted in Baton.jsx. Changed by a concurrent motion pass during this build; features.tabs-dark motion is tabs.instant only.
